evidence: Caes. BG 7.8: in Arvernōs versus; Cic. Lael. 96: in forum versus (Lewis & Short s.v. vertō, for the construction)
terms.comment: Versus here is an adverb, “turned towards”, added to in with the accusative, as Caesar and Cicero use it. Every word is classical; we have found no classical instance of the phrase.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Lewis & Short: verto · Lewis & Short: oriens
